verdict.rationale: AgentMail publishes its own API reference section and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and the dashboard shows SDK code examples in popovers. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the browser. Missing for 10: a documented interactive 'try it' API explorer, runnable in-page examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: All of our SDKs are open source and available under the MIT license.
Praise for the dashboard's popovers showing SDK examples: 'a brilliant UI idea (executed with great polish)'
